title: Ribbon categories from ind-exact algebras: simple current case
summary: We give criteria for when finitely generated local modules over a commutative algebra $A$ in the ind-completion $\widehat{\mathcal{C}}$ of a braided tensor category $\mathcal{C}$ inherit the structure of a (rigid, braided, ribbon) tensor category. We then apply this to simple current algebras $A = \bigoplus_{g \in Γ} E_g$, where $Γ$ is a subgroup of invertible objects in $\mathcal{C}$.
